GraceDeployment.Target: Public GitHub repository xronocode/smart-review (skills installed with npx skills add, plus a Claude Code plugin manifest) and an npm package for the scoring and lint CLI
GraceDeployment.Notes: Releases are tagged versions with a CHANGELOG entry. CI must pass before a release: structure validation, link check, secret scan, and CLI tests. Publishing to npm and pushing tags are done by the maintainer, not automatically. Rollback is a new patch release; the previous npm version stays installable.
